name: Sato Video Player
author: poragjyotigogoi

sections.description:
Sato Video Player is a no-code HTML5 video player builder for WordPress. You can visually build a branded video experience and embed it on WordPress sites. With 80+ customizations to control how the player looks and the embedded video behaves on the site, it is a powerful tool to ensure the video player looks like an intentional part of your design.

Sato Video Player comes with cloud storage and a delivery infrastructure which enables you to store and host videos directly from your Sato Player account to wherever you embed the player. This reduces the extra step of hosting your videos separately and then linking it to a player and makes it easier to manage and monitor your videos from a single window.

Sato also comes with video marketing tools designed specifically to engage and convert viewers into buyers. Be it shoppable call-to-actions or sponsored ads, run it within your videos, straight from the Sato Video Player WordPress plugin.

Key Features

  • Style the player UI to match it your aesthetics.
  • Add brand colors and logo to make it fully yours.
  • Control how the video behaves on the website after it is embedded.
  • Store and manage videos in a secured video library.
  • Stream directly by connecting a player to videos from your library.
  • Light-weight embed that prioritizes your website performance.
  • Distraction-free viewing experience for your viewers.

Premium Features (Available in Paid Sato Player subscriptions)

  • Build players from pre-made themes.
  • Generate and enable speech-to-text closed captions for accessibility.
  • Keep your viewers engaged till the end with Super progress.
  • Convert viewers into bottom-of-the-funnel lead with call-to-action cards within videos.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Sign in to your Sato Player account or Sign up to Sato Player.
  3. Select or create a player within the Sato Video Player plugin on WordPress.
  4. Customize as you want.
  5. Save all your changes.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode.
  7. Paste the shortcode into any page or post.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Sato Player service to provide video player functionality, including player configuration, media management, and delivery of user-configured content.

The plugin communicates with the Sato Player backend to retrieve the information required to provide the service.

Users may upload and manage images and videos through the Sato Player service. User-uploaded media associated with a Sato Player configuration is stored on Sato Player’s servers and may be delivered through BunnyCDN. These media files are dynamically associated with the user’s Sato Player configuration and are not static assets or dependencies of this WordPress plugin.

The plugin uses the following external services:

  • Sato Player API — Used to communicate with the Sato Player backend and retrieve player configuration and information required by the plugin.
  • Sato Image CDN (BunnyCDN) — Used to deliver images uploaded or configured by users through the Sato Player service.
  • Sato Video CDN (BunnyCDN) — Used to deliver video content associated with the user’s Sato Player configuration.

The plugin’s own JavaScript, CSS, images, fonts, and other static assets are packaged locally within the plugin and are not loaded from these external services.

Use of the Sato Video Player functionality requires a Sato Player account.

For more information about how data is handled, please see:
Privacy Policy | Terms of Service

Development

The plugin’s frontend is built using React and Vite. The distributed plugin contains the compiled production assets generated from the publicly available source code.
The source code and build configuration for this plugin are publicly available here.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sato-video-player/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the Sato Video Player plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Sato Video Player from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. If new user, Sato Player will open on a separate tab where you will need to sign up.
  5. Existing Sato player users can directly login and start using it.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid plan to build and customize video players?

No. You can build and customize video players even in our free plans. Our free plan gives you access to all design features.

Can I change the logo on the video player?

Yes. You can change the logo on the video player even if you are on the free forever plan.

What happens if I consume more bandwidth or storage than provided in any of the plans?

We understand different sets of teams will use Sato for different reasons. For that, we have set separate storage and monthly bandwidth limits for each tier. In case at any point of time it is exhausted, add-on storage and bandwidth can be purchased. Bandwidth and storage add-on is, however, available only for those in any of the paid Sato Player tiers. Users in the Starter tier will have to upgrade to any of the paid plans for add-ons.

Does the plugin upload videos on WordPress?

No. All videos and other assets are uploaded only on your Sato Player account which is hosted at app.satoplayer.com and not on WordPress.
